method: Read84original Japanese paragraphs169–175, then read85current paragraphs after one addition. sourceVisualReview.recognitionNotes: Source electrical-tool photo, metallic/flexible conduit, end cover, exposed switch box, outlet/pull boxes, plaster cover and two connector photo examples read with captions. existingKnowledgeElsewhere.purpose: General electrical-safety/isolation context is already shared; not proof of phase/outlet testing competence.

freshPrimaryReferences.scope: Selected three-phase sequence versus line-voltage distinction and model-limited functions; no setup/test-operation approval.

remainingObjectives: Verify product-specific outlet tester findings, conduit dimensions/markings and bonding-conductor requirements before adding operating or legal detail.

Generic structural openings and metal tube/coupling words do not authorize copying composite electrical lessons across fields; broader source comparison remains open.
